title: Portinari color palette — portinari.pal
text: Palettes come three categories (see portinari.palettes()): qualitative palettes unordered groups, sequential palettes ordered values, diverging palettes values around meaningful midpoint. title: PortinariColors 0.3.0
text: Initial CRAN submission. Discrete scales now work ggplot2 < 3.5.0, requires scale_name. Palettes now style, RColorBrewer MetBrewer: qualitative (cafe, paz), diverging (retirantes, inah, sofia, guerra) sequential (guerra_azul, paz_ouro). portinari.palettes() show_portinari() gain category filter. New sequential palettes guerra_azul paz_ouro, derived UN panels. Palettes stored MetBrewer-style: colors display order plus order ranking discrete picks. Discrete subsets now suit style: sequential diverging palettes keep ends (light center), qualitative palettes keep distinct colors. colors returned given n changed every palette. sofia now colorblind-safe first 3 colors (2). New portinari.works() lists paintings behind palette links. Hex logo: portrait Portinari light shades guerra. pkgdown site two articles: “paintings” (images links every reference work) “Choosing palette style”.

title: PortinariColors 0.2.0
text: New palettes guerra (9 colors, colorblind-safe) paz (8 colors, first 4 colorblind-safe), Portinari’s Guerra Paz panels United Nations Headquarters. Continuous palettes scales now interpolate along smooth ramp order stored palette, instead discrete priority order. Gradients every palette smoother result.

title: PortinariColors 0.1.0
text: First release: portinari.pal(), scale_color_portinari(), scale_colour_portinari(), scale_fill_portinari(), portinari.palettes(), portinari.cvd.check() show_portinari(). Four palettes: cafe, retirantes, inah, sofia. Two colorblind-safe colors, two subset.
